title: Billing Holds — Cost Sharing Owed in Medical Hardship Costs
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), cost sharing posted on the held account is added to the qualifying medical debt documented with the other medical costs, leaving aside every liability posted from the claim under appeal.

- **Held account**: the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account on a billing hold for a charge dispute or, when no account is on such a hold, the account on a billing hold for an itemization review (when several accounts qualify, the one listed first among the patient's accounts).
- **Claim under appeal**: the claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity), while that claim is in appealed status.
- **Hold window**: a liability belongs to it when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the documentation day, a whole month running from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it.

| Held account | Further conditions | Added |
|---|---|---|
| on an itemization-review hold | an itemized statement has been issued on it | its coinsurance liabilities of the hold window |
| on a charge-dispute hold | its financial class is self-pay, its self-pay final-bill liabilities are above zero, and the most recent charge-dispute inquiry on it (on a tie in creation time, the inquiry listed first) names a charge line | the uninsured discount part of that line |
| otherwise | — | nothing |

The **uninsured discount part of that line** is the smaller of that line's charge and the held account's patient liabilities of the hold window, times the account's uninsured discount rate (the uninsured discount posted on its most recent self-pay final-bill liability divided by that liability, a discount posted on any other line, such as an observation-rate discount, not counted), rounded half-up to the cent, a correction of that line lowering the patient's balance only by its charge less that discount.

**Worked case (hypothetical).** Charge-dispute hold on a self-pay account; disputed line 800.00; patient liabilities of the hold window 1,000.00; a most recent self-pay final-bill liability of 3,000.00 carrying an uninsured discount of 1,500.00, a rate of one half (an observation-rate discount of 500.00 posted on an observation line of the same account is not counted). The smaller of 800.00 and 1,000.00 is 800.00, and 400.00 is added.
